data.explanation: Your employer, Beispiel Logistik GmbH, sent you a supplementary agreement (Zusatzvereinbarung) to your employment contract allowing mobile working (Homeoffice) up to two days per week, starting 1 June 2026. They ask you to sign it and send it back to HR by the deadline shown, counted in working days (Monday–Saturday, excluding public holidays) from the date of this letter. The letter does not state what happens if you miss this deadline, but it's best to return it promptly so the mobile-working arrangement can start as planned. If you have questions about the terms, you can contact the HR department directly.

The employee is asked to sign and return it to HR within 10 working days (Mon–Sat, excluding holidays) of the letter's date.
